people.name: David
people.line: Anointed king of Israel, ancestor of Jesus Christ

people.name: Gath
people.line: Philistine city; home of Goliath; refuge for David

translations.web: So David would not move Yahweh’s ark to be with him in David’s city; but David carried it aside into Obed-Edom the Gittite’s house.
translations.bsb: So he was unwilling to move the ark of the LORD to the City of David; instead, he took it aside to the house of Obed-edom the Gittite.
translations.kjv: So David would not remove the ark of the LORD unto him into the city of David: but David carried it aside into the house of Obededom the Gittite.
translations.asv: So David would not remove the ark of Jehovah unto him into the city of David; but David carried it aside into the house of Obed-edom the Gittite.
